disclosures.benchmark_incomparability: E1 and E2 backtest numbers are numerically incomparable (different benchmark). Head 2's DV is benchmark-free.

teacher_v12_exact_set_error.rule: demote iff Wilson lower bound STRICTLY > 0.35 (boundary equality does NOT demote)

disclosures.head2_dividend_caveat: Prices are split-adjusted only. The DV is NOT dividend-immune: an ex-dividend session inside the post window inflates it.
disclosures.head2_forward_fill_caveat: controls.load_price_matrix forward-fills inside each CIK's own coverage window, so a non-trading gap appears as a zero return and deflates both DV components; the count of events with a flat session in the post window is in the census block.
disclosures.head2_predictor_caveat: sentiment is the field G2 ruled INDETERMINATE; the escorts that must travel with a sentiment-based row (including the stored NEGATIVE recall and precision) are enumerated in the G3 document, §11.
disclosures.head2_scored_span: The scored span ends at the document's head2.last_event_quarter (decision 12): the snapshot's terminal event quarter is partial, so scoring it would mix a part-quarter cluster with full ones. The events dropped by that boundary are counted in the census block (events_dropped_after_last_event_quarter), and the scored cluster count is clusters_event_quarters_scored -- a few-clusters setting either way.
disclosures.head3_claim_scope: The claim is 'exit', never 'distress': the stored distress_events table carries `items` only on 8-K rows, so Form 25 / Form 15 exits cannot be split into M&A and distress.
disclosures.head3_exit_screen_caveat: head3.exit_screen is a PROXY, not a corporate record: a stored exit row is treated as a non-exit when the same CIK keeps filing in membership more than a year later. Rows filed within a year of the panel's last feature date cannot be judged either way -- the predicate's silence there is missing data, not evidence -- so they are counted (exit_rows_unscreenable_within_365d_of_panel_end) and kept. Every screened count is in the census block beside the result.
disclosures.label_quality: Label-quality constants are E2's own (teacher v1.2 spot-check and G2); E1's 36.6%/63.4% constants are never carried onto Qwen labels.
disclosures.validation: Walk-forward by construction: head 3 trains only on quarters strictly before the test quarter; head 2 is an event study whose predictor is dated at the event filing and whose windows are placed strictly after the news session. No number here is an expected return and nothing here is a trading signal.

estimate.few_clusters_limitation: 40 clusters (event quarters). The wild-cluster bootstrap is approximate in this regime; the SE and p-values are reported with this limitation attached, never alone.
